purpose: Offline prospective design and operating-review schema assessment

reviewer.mode: Unmasked method review of existing candidate and one evolving gate function

method_finding: The candidate already declares the user-requested deterministic F0 allocation endpoint and separate immutable raw diagnostic endpoint. A new final approved-design wrapper and separate execution freeze/gate are required; the existing candidate must not be relabeled or overwritten.

errors.reason: Normal raw sum, label, citation, explanation and complete-generation structure errors are outcomes. Unattempted independent cells, unexplained missing F0 after completed D0, unresolved system stops and binding/accounting failures remain operating obstacles. No success-directed retry or text repair is introduced.

consistency.reason: The held-out five-cell main design keeps the frozen v494 prompt bytes, same common task and model controls, own actual D0/full history, source timing E/L/C, original r2 semantic rubric and explicit evaluator-only endpoint amendment.

paper_topic.reason: Source evidence -> source interpretation -> stated reasoning -> submitted allocation remains the question. The primary operational vector is model plus fixed finalizer; claims about the model are assessed on raw submission first. No investment performance, optimal weights, causal or population inference is authorized.

operating_feasibility.reason: Required nonempty evidence-based explanation of observed timing, failures, capacity and feasibility; this string is a schema example, not an actual verdict.

required_operating_review.continuation_terminal_ref: Exact path+SHA256 required after terminal record exists
required_operating_review.continuation_summary_ref: Exact path+SHA256 required after summary exists
required_operating_review.completed_at_utc: At or after bound continuation terminal timestamp
required_operating_review.retained_prior_incident_refs: Retain the original Fidelity L infrastructure failure and retry authorization; an empty current unresolved list must not erase it.
limits: All four independent continuation cells must have one accounted D0 attempt. A normally completed D0 requires its own F0 attempt. A normal structure/output-limit/case-timeout D0 can have no dependent F0 with an explicit recorded reason.
All attempted stages require structural/error/source/context/topic audit or an explicit unavailable/partial scope record. Review completion is not semantic success.
No requirement that all four finals, valid raw vectors, source readings, citations or derived vectors succeed.
At least four and at most eight new generation attempts, each exactly one; preserve historical3 plus newactual count separately and campaign maximum11.
A series of timeouts is not automatically feasible: the positive feasibility reason must explain actual operational evidence and remaining limits.
A system stop that leaves later independent cells unattempted is unresolved operating coverage, even when earlier outputs are readable.

required_final_main_protocol.recorded_at_utc: After continuation operating review and before any main generation
required_final_main_protocol.endpoint_override: Explicitly incorporate candidate.endpoint_contract, including primary derived F0 and original r2 raw-diagnostic continuity.
required_final_main_protocol.permission_boundary: main_allowed=true establishes the final design scope only. Separate approved_for_main_before_generation gate and new immutable source/runtime/freeze refs remain mandatory.

remaining_before_main: Finish the running continuation attempt sequence and preserve actual terminal accounting; no partial live outputs are counted.
Complete all attempted-stage reviews with explicit missing/unassessed scope and separate raw/derived diagnostics; record actual continuation operating review.
Complete and independently verify separate main runtime/gate/finalizer adapters and meaningful synthetic orchestration/failure/cleanup tests against their final bytes.

Bind actual native main D0 token-capacity results for all five prepared messages; validate each F0 dynamically against its own actual raw D0 before that request. Synthetic F0 is not actual-stage capacity proof.
Create the new final protocol wrapper, new main freeze and separate main gate with final prepared inputs, reviewed two wording amendments, exact evaluator/finalizer/settings and all evidence hashes.
Preserve prior failures, immutable pilot artifacts and same-source/common-market dependence. Do not reuse pilot C or L drafts as main requests.

specific_design_limits.primary_endpoint_tradeoff: Normalization erases budget-scale differences and can change comparator-relative signs; quantization can split ties. Raw residual and prose truth remain visible; finalized arithmetic does not retroactively validate raw reasoning.
specific_design_limits.source_text: Only the already reviewed Fidelity Q3 Financials and UBS July Utilities wording changes are allowed; source-specific labels are not mapped into a common preference score.
specific_design_limits.timing: 2026-07-17 exclusive cutoff / last market observation July16; retrospective October retrieval/cache evidence does not establish exact historical byte availability or a trading replay.
specific_design_limits.reported_date: Preserve Fidelity invalid printed 6/31/26 as unresolved/normalized null; distinguish source publication, landing-page update, source-view and observation dates.
specific_design_limits.comparison: Finite descriptive E/L/C contrasts with the same shared C and same market. No p-values, balanced independent sample, causal effect, human reliability, target portfolio or profit claim.

implementation_observation.finding: Read-only draft review agrees with required scope. Runtime owner was asked to require nonempty feasibility reason and agreed. Code may still evolve; this record is not final implementation approval or executable gate.
